notes.title: BAWK BAWK UPDATE 1.12
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/7d011a4607f466729e2dd37b118a019d7fbea04e.png[/img]

Howdy Heroes,

[h2]Pufferfish Protection Powers[/h2]
This update adds 3 new mythic hero mission items: Puffer Cap, Puffer Vest and Puffer Slippers that help unlock your inner Pufferfish Protection Powers and save you in a pinch! Always remember to just keep swimming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/e78cf55ee04c0dd7a3855b10e5b1da66786e8705.gif[/img]

[h2]Shine Bright Like A… Lamp[/h2]
This update also adds Lumen’s Lamp to the shop for those who have purchased the full game. Wearing Lumen’s Lamp will continuously make you shine helping you tackle the spooky levels where the darkness tries to creep in.

[h2]The Nitty Gritty[/h2]
[h3]Items[/h3][list]
[u]New[/u][list]
[*][b]Lumen’s Lamp[/b] - [i]Body[/i] - [i]Mythic[/i] - Unlocked by owning the full game.[list]
[*][u]Wild Shine[/u][i] - Apply the Shine buff every 32-42s. Gain a small boost when any Shine buff is applied. Immune to Spooked.[/i]
[*][u]Light armour[/u][i] - +10% Turn Speed per Armour.[/i]
[*]+2 armour
[*]+1 water bounce
[*]breaks[/list]
[*][b]Puffer Cap[/b] - [i]Head[/i] - [i]Mythic[/i] - Unlocked by being in time slow for 720 seconds.[list]
[*]+1 [u]Puff Protection[/u][/list]
[*][b]Puffer Vest[/b] - [i]Body[/i] - [i]Mythic[/i] - Unlocked by being in time slow for 360 seconds.[list]
[*]+1 [u]Puff Protection[/u][/list]
[*][b]Puffer Slippers[/b] - [i]Legs[/i] - [i]Mythic[/i] - Unlocked by being in time slow for 180 seconds.[list]
[*]+1 [u]Puff Protection[/u][/list]
[u]Puff Protection[/u][i] - gain invulnerability when your dodge time is below 70% and each piece recharges over 300 seconds.[/i][/list]
[u]Adjustments[/u][list]
[*][b]Hero Shield[/b][list]
[*]Now hero dodge procs at 70% dodge time or 0.7s whichever is smaller.[/list]
[*][b]Mummy Wraps[/b][list]
[*]Cursed now builds up spooked over time.[/list]
[*][b]Witch Shoes[/b][list]
[*]Bawking as a super frog now only requires 1 charge but bawk regen and recovery is slowed.
[*]Increased dash duration as a super frog.
[*]All super frog dashes are phase dashes.[/list][/list][/list]
[h3]Levels[/h3][list]
[u]Adjustments[/u][list]
[*]Golden eggs are now worth 10 eggs from 8.
[*]Increased dash duration as a frog.
[*]Now Sheep, Mummies and Teeth look in the direction they are traveling.
[*]Sprinkler walls now spray water in 6 streams and look less like sheets of water.
[*]Reduced shuttlecocks tracking speed.
[*]Eye stalks now track slower, apply less darkness and don’t track when Clucky is too high or too low.[/list][/list]
[h3]Missions[/h3][list]
[*]Now you can have more than 1 item or level instant mission per day as long as you have finished the previous one.
[*]Now once you finish all instant missions you will get a random instant rather than the same mission over and over.
[*]Added input delays to clicking missions in the list.[/list]
[h3]QoL[/h3][list]
[*]Water bouncing should feel more consistent.
[*]Rascal’s and Clucky’s dirt boosts now spawn golden eggs and have boost indicators. Rascal collects his egg straight away.
[*]Clucky can now go bawk bowling while frogged.
[*]Bawk splitters can now split bawks even when bawk bowling!!??!
[*]When slimed dodge time doesn’t stop you from true danger (water) with a bawk bowling bawk charge up.[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3][list]
[*]Adjusted dirt spawning and removed unseen dirt faces.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where bawk was disabled for the run if you got slimed with Witch Shoes on.
[*]Fixed a bug where sounds would try to play on destroyed objects.
[*]Fixed a bug where the event modal popup would show when returning from a level.
[*]Fixed a bug which caused dirt to spawn in between two water blocks in water levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could trigger a close call and teleport to the ground when running into dirt walls while having the bowling ball equipped.
[*]Fixed a bug where multiple shoutouts occurred during armour boost.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get rascal boosts during cannon with peg legs and rascal bag on.[/list]

Patch Notes for Update 1.12
Release date: 2024/11/17

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/19104d61cc946e98aa5d8c4a3a0a13106384d141.gif[/img]

Howdy Heroes,
[h2]Haunting Horrors[/h2]
Haunting Horrors area is now available to play! With it comes 8 levels, 8 bonus levels, 1 trial level, 5 common, 2 rare and 1 mythic items! As well as 3 new hero missions each with a rare item reward. The Witch set will have you turning into a Super Frog and ribbeting all over the place. Meanwhile the Cyborg set will have you firing more bawks than you can count. Watch out for those dancing skeletons and try not to get spooked! Be sure to check it out and be the first to set some new global highscores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/ea9e6bfc88a6a92735e23b334b2aa6423dd967b0.gif[/img]

[h2]Spooky Season[/h2]
[u]October 8th to November 15th[/u]
During the Spooky Season Event 5 item missions including 4 NEW MYTHICS will be yours to complete! The Bat Wings that will have you flapping around while the Wolf Paws will have you leaping in bounds. Mummy wraps for those of you who like to be armored and a Skele Jumper for those who love dashing forever. If that wasn’t enough, there’s 5 infinite missions to help you pump up those egg numbers so you can unlock them all.

[h2]PAX Aus[/h2]
We’re heading to PAX Aus 11 - 13 October, 2024 at the MCEC in Melbourne. We’re excited to see everyone test out the new Spooky area. We will even be hosting a high score tournament for the chance to win a free Steam key, as well as giving out sticker packs to those who follow our socials. If you happen to be passing through please come and say hello to us. We’d love to hear your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/6c7fc42e00ec39bdff4927c0f186ef1c59a20b76.png[/img]
Patch Notes for Update 1.6
Release date: 2024/2/7

Howdy Heroes,

Just a quick shoutout that we are very excited to be showcasing Bawk Bawk at [url=sagameexhibition.com] SAGE[/url] this February!


[h2]Ease of Play[/h2]
Clucky’s has some major upgrades to her basic abilities such as falling slower, gliding longer, turning faster and bigger boosts. New player experience has been optimized and there should be no more deaths on the tutorial/training levels. Catching rascal should be accessible to all players so he has decided to turn slower and less often. Don’t worry though if you want a challenge there's now an elusive 4 star Rascal and Challenge missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/f85a276423074b67c7778b1b112342919623fbaa.gif[/img]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
We wanted to live a little and explore some new features for those who have already seen what Bawk Bawk has to offer. We’ve added Chippies and Doughnuts for those who are hungry for more bonus levels. There’s also [b]17 NEW ITEMS[/b] for you to mix and match and find the best combinations. Float through the skies in the Chicken Suit or race through the stars at an amped up 300% speed wearing the new Star Mythics. We’ve even added a new cinematic video to help you explore Clucky’s world in a new way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/fd5baf901d27a26a1c3b3482c58d4d4cc494f115.gif[/img]
[h2]Mission Items & Event[/h2]
We have expanded our missions tab to have more to do such as challenge missions that require extreme skill to complete and hero missions that last forever and unlock some of those new items. Don’t worry, we know the struggle of trying to work out where your mission is so now you can just click/press the mission to go straight to the required level or equip the required item. Lastly we have added some extra event missions until the end of February just to help you top up your eggs ready to buy the new items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/369234774bea7e6972a835d6ac9c7f48ac56a21f.gif[/img]
[h2]The Nitty Gritty[/h2]
[h3]Cinematic Video[/h3][list]
[*]The game now plays the cinematic trailer before the tutorial when you first play Super Bawk Bawk Chicken!
[*]The cinematic trailer can be accessed from the credits page in options.[/list]
[h3]Clucky[/h3][list]
[u]Falling[/u][list]
[*]Clucky can now vault over edges easier.
[*]Clucky’s base fall speed from 100% to 80%.[/list]
[u]Glide Time[/u][list]
[*]Clucky’s base glide time from 1.2s to 2s.
[*]Unused glide time is now pushed into Clucky’s next jump’s glide time up to a max of 100% glide time.
[*]Now all jumps after Clucky’s initial jump give 50% glide time from 50% previous jumps glide time.[/list]
[u]Movement[/u][list]
[*]Clucky’s base acceleration increased from 90 to 120.
[*]Clucky’s movement is now based on distance and not degrees. This means the higher you are the slower you rotate.[/list]
[u]Dashing[/u][list]
[*]Clucky’s base dash recovery time from 1s to 2s.
[*]Clucky’s base dash recharge time from 6s to 10s.
[*]Clucky will now turn purple when phase dashing.[/list]
[u]Dodge Time[/u][list]
[*]Clucky’s time slow trail now only renders when consuming dodge time or when waiting for specific input in the tutorial/training levels.[/list][/list]
[h3]Rascal[/h3][list]
[*]Turn Speed decreased from 25/35/45 to 20/30/40/50
[*]Turn Acceleration decreased from 180 to 40/60/80/100 (0.5s to go from 0 to max or 1s from -max to max)
[*]Turn Duration increased from 6/5/4 to 7/6/5/4 seconds.
[*]Dash Cooldown increased from 30/15/2 to 30/20/10/4 seconds.[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3][list]
[u]New Items[/u][list]
[*][b]Party Tutu[/b] and [b]Party Shoes[/b] - +50% Star Power. Unlocked straight away.
[*][b]Chicken Suit Hat[/b], [b]Chicken Suit Body[/b] and [b]Chicken Suit Legs[/b] - +1 Jump Charge, -100% Fall Speed, -16% Glide Time and -8% Jump Height. They are half price at 600 eggs each and are unlocked to purchase by buying the full game.
[*][b]Rascal Mask[/b] - Egg Combo Phase Dash and +111% to +222% magnet based on egg combo up to 500 eggs. Unlocked by catching Rascal.
[*][b]Rascal Bag[/b] - Egg Combo Boost and +111% to +222% magnet based on egg combo up to 500 eggs. Unlocked by catching Rascal.
[*][b]Rascal Paws[/b] - Coyote Jump, +1s to +2s Coyote Time and +111% to +222% magnet based on egg combo up to 500 eggs. Unlocked by catching Rascal.
[*][b]Thrillseekers Helmet[/b], [b]Thrillseekers Cape[/b] and [b]Thrillseekers Boots[/b] - +1 Max Cannon Star, +10% Free Cannon Ride Chance and unlocked by taking the cannon.
[*][b]Star Tiara[/b], [b]Star Backpack[/b] and [b]Star Sneakers[/b] - +1 Star Shield and are unlocked by collecting stars.
[*][b]Hero Cap[/b] - Hero Bawk, +7 Bawk Charges, +35% Bawk Recharge and Bawk Consumes All Charges and is unlocked by completing instant missions.
[*][b]Hero Shield[/b] - Hero Dodge, No Dodge Time Slow, -50% Dodge Recovery and is unlocked by completing instant missions.
[*][b]Hero Boots[/b] - Hero Dash, +9 Dash Charges, +35% Dash Recharge and Dash Consumes All Charges and is unlocked by completing instant missions.[/list]
[u]Adjustments[/u][list]
[*][b]Party Hat[/b], [b]Party Tutu[/b], [b]Party Shoes[/b] - Star Power scaling 10% per star cap from 150% at 3rd red star to 180% at the 3rd purple star. Party items now cost 400 eggs.
[*][b]Jet Pack[/b] - Jump Power from -25% to -20%. Now sits higher on Clucky in the menu.
[*][b]High heels[/b] - Star Power from +50% to 0%. Now Recovers 100% Dodge Time when passing a star.
[*][b]Handbag[/b] - Star Power from +50% to +10%. Now Recharges 100% Dash and Bawk Charges when passing a star.
[*][b]Cat Headphones[/b] - Dash Recharge from +100% to 0%. Dash Recovery from -200% to +100%. Dash Distance from -50% to -25%.
[*][b]FPS Shades[/b] - Bawk Recovery from 150% to 50%. Bawk Recharge from 150% to 25%.
[*][b]Glider[/b] - Glide Time from +50% to +40%.
[*][b]Glasses[/b] - Dodge Recovery from +30% to +15%.
[*][b]Heroic Cape[/b] - Dodge Recovery from +50% to +25%.
[*][b]Sage Scroll[/b] - Bawk Recharge from +60% to +25%.
[*][b]Leg Warmers[/b] - Dash Recharge from +60% to +25%.
[*][b]Steel Toes[/b] - Fall Speed from +50% to +80%.
[*][b]Chest Plate[/b] - Now all stats scale with Armour: from -20% Turn Speed to -10% Turn Speed per Armour, from +10% Gravity to -2% Gravity per Armour. [/list][/list]
[h3]Missions[/h3][list]
[u]New Mission Types[/u][list]
[b]Event missions[/b] are for special limited time events and require the full game.
[b]Daily missions[/b] generate new missions when you achieve them and refresh daily.
[b]Rascal missions[/b] involve catching Rascal to get rewards and refresh every 2 days.
[b]Challenge missions[/b] involve completing difficult tasks in a single run and refresh every 3 days.
[b]Weekly missions[/b] are big tasks that you can tackle over the week.
[b]Hero missions[/b] unlock new cool items, never expire and require the full game.[/list]
[*]Pressing a mission will now equip the required item or take you to the required level.
[*]Added a new mission time Boost X Times.
[*]Adjusted some mission descriptions to be more accurate.
[*]Missions can now have multiple stages.
[*]Adjusted missions appearance to fit the new system.
[*]Missions now say their percentage instead of counter/requirement.
[*]Missions bar and complete text is now green when complete.
[*]Missions now show the closest you got for missions that require a certain amount in one run.
[*]Missions now tell you how to unlock Rascal missions.[/list]
[h3]Levels[/h3][list]
[u]New Bonus Levels[/u][list]
[*]Added Delicious Dougnuts bonus level to Pleasant Pastures.
[*]Added Soggy Corn, Dash Dash Dogs and Hay Listen bonus levels to Frantic Farms.
[*]Added Barrelled bonus level to Bustlin’ Barnyard.
[*]Added Crashing Chippies bonus level to Lethal Lava.[/list]
[u]Bigger Boosts[/u][list]
[*]Boosts base duration increased from 0.66s to 2.5s.
[*]Stone and ring boosts now suck clucky towards their center.
[*]Stone boosts are now wider and have thinner stone edges.
[*]Trampoline boost now lasts 1s.
[*]Dirt boosts now last 1.5s or 1s if Rascal created it.

[*]First tutorial is now shorter and players should be less likely to fail.
[*]Double jump input tutorial line has been adjusted to be more intuitive and allow for both double press or two more spaced out presses.
[*]Glide now tells you to “hold jump” when you stop gliding prematurely in the tutorial.
[*]Tutorial time slow lines no longer are removed on restart.
[*]Boost areas in tutorials are now filled with more than just grass.
[*]Now when you fail on tutorial/training you will reset back to the last tutorial line passed.
[*]Obstacles will no longer dissolve completely as you pass them. Now the dissolve maxes at 75% so you will always be able to see the obstacles you run into.
[*]Messy Muds tutorial now explains lily pads.[/list]
[*]Walled has been adjusted to have bigger gaps between the walls.
[*]Stone Walls with 1 opening now give a little extra distance before them.
[*]Sheepish Corn has been adjusted to have better looking wheat.
[*]Snakes now have a metallic sheen.

[*]Snakes now hiss when they strike.
[*]Lava steps now move slower.[/list]
[h3]Controls[/h3][list]
[*]The gyro controls should now work before first death.

[*]The joystick now shows the current movement from the gyro.

[*]The gyro should now have less drift.
[*]The gyro center position is now calculated at the end of the countdown.[/list]
[h3]UI and UX[/h3][list]
[*]The dash button will now go purple when you have a phase dash.
[*]The pause button should now be easier to press.
[*]Items in the shop are now shown in slot, tier and alphabetical order.
[*]Tutorial button guides now loop their animation.
[*]Selecting a tab button now counts as pressing that button so the current view will always be the selected tab.
[*]Improved the scrolling for prefixes and suffixes when changing your player name and when scrolling through missions.
[*]When buttons aren’t allowed during tutorial and training the buttons are now more transparent (from 25% to 5%) to indicate they are locked and lower confusion as to why they don’t work.
[*]Profile online settings tick is now darker.
[*]Adjusted some level icons in bonus areas so each icon is unique for that area.
[*]Options scrollbar is wider.
[*]There is now a back button for the equipment item slot selection.[/list]

[*]Increased the amount of materials that are GPU instanced.
[*]Increased the amount of models that have LODs such as: Barns, Stone Boosts, Stones, Fertilizer, Cabbage, Snakes, Eggs, Bees, Ducks and Ducklings.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/6c7fc42e00ec39bdff4927c0f186ef1c59a20b76.png[/img]
Patch Notes for version 1.5
Release date: 2023/12/12

Howdy Heroes,

We’ve been working hard alongside our composer [url=https://www.instagram.com/therealchrisnorton/]therealchrisnorton[/url] to make sure the Music update and Mobile release makes a big splash! Our focus for this patch was to bring a unique soundtrack to the game, improving the player’s experience and optimisation to make sure it runs as smooth as possible. We are happy to welcome you to the Music and Mobile update!

[h2]Mobile Mad[/h2]
[b]Play On The Go[/b] - Bawk Bawk’s mobile release on Android and iOS will be right around the corner! Soon enough you’ll be Bawking at a moment's notice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/5769ea2d8660c537cb30b58289e39c0f22b6484d.png[/img]

[h2]Masterful Music[/h2]
[b]Stop, Look, LISTEN[/b] - Now Bawk Bawk is jam packed with new awesome music composed by @therealchrisnorton! Be sure to play with the sound on and the music pumping, treat your ears to a delightful feast. Even Rascal has his own theme to help you know when the chase is on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/3783b849b5bc55bc5d5d1d5861e57f005ec723f2.png[/img]

[h2]Player Experience[/h2]
[b]First Impressions Matter[/b] - We’ve updated the tutorial to give players a better first experience, while also covering more of the core mechanics.
[b]Navigation Nation[/b] - Improved navigation based on player feedback. The post game screen is now a lot easier to navigate and the chilli meter now makes it even easier to switch the tempo of gameplay. You now have the ability to change Clucky’s equipment from both the post game and level select screens so you can adjust your outfit on the fly.
[b]My Clucky Senses Are Tingling[/b] - Clucky now senses which direction she should turn to find Rascal when he moves out of sight. Clucky can now also sense when a fox is close behind her.
[b]Cheers, Big Ears[/b] - A shout-out system is in the game, providing positive reinforcement for completing tutorials as well as highlighting daring dodges and clutch saves.
[b]Second Chances[/b] - The new Close Call system gives you more time to react to a collision that would have proved fatal. Use this time to move, dash, or bawk your way to safety. But watch out! The dodge timer drains rapidly during close calls and if you take too long to react, your run will still be over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/46f929192f0f98d82bffacb9d5cf32c4d14e61bc.gif[/img]

[h2]Hot Stuff[/h2]
[b]Super Scary[/b] - Fire scarecrows now bounce around while they spin so watch out for these spinning nightmares!
[b]Hex Walled[/b] - A new challenge approaches in the form of a new bonus level, it’s like walled only hexed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/ef3d250aeaf4c47a591688a8db8f469072383e9f.gif[/img]

[h2]Optimisation Override[/h2]
[b]Staying Positive[/b] - Removed all negative scales in bawk bawk that were used to flip objects and used mirrored animation/assets instead to increase gpu instancing performance.
[b]Too Many Triangles[/b] - Added LODs for the cylindrical world and some heavy hitting obstacles reducing the total polys by up to 40% in some cases.
[b]Quality Assurance[/b] - Reduced the texture quality of the “alright” and “not bad” quality settings, allowing for less overhead on low-end devices.

[h2]The Nitty Gritty[/h2]
[h3]Music and Sound Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*] Added new songs for each area, two songs for the menu and one song for Rascal.
[*] Added new countdown sounds unique to each area.
[*] Added new sound effects for bawk and dash recharge.
[*] Added sound effects to all menus.
[*] Music now fades out during load transition.
[*] Music is paused when you pause.
[*] Sounds should appear more like they are in a constant environment.
[*] Obstacle sounds can now be played at various pitches to reduce the same sound stacking effect.
[*] Added new sound effects for some actions.
[*] Frogs now play sounds appropriate to their size.
[*] Adjusted the volume of many sounds.
[*] Reduced the amount of donkey and cow sounds and they should now play at the correct time.
[*] Dogs that run should now bark.
[*] Music dips on passing a goal.
[*] Lava area should now sound more echoey.[/list]
[h3]Rascal Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*] Rascal music now plays when rascal spawns.
[*] When caught you gain the eggs Rascal stole and an egg combo shield.
[*] Rascal now dashes when Clucky boosts near him.
[*] Rascal now moves faster when behind clucky.
[*] Rascal will now appear in front of you and leave a dirt trail leading into his boost. The dirt trail destroys surrounding obstacles.
[*] Rascal’s item bag colour now changes based on the reward you get for catching them.
[*] Rascal no longer impacts the level's random seed and won’t change the level’s structure when present.
[*] Rascal’s chase should last exactly one minute.
[*] Rascal’s icon and “catch/caught/escaped” text are now smaller.
[*] Fixed a bug where the stunned icon stayed active during Rascal’s initial burst of speed.
[*] Fixed a bug where both “catch” and “caught” remained on the screen during Rascal’s chase.
[*] Fixed a bug Rascal didn’t spawn after completing a tutorial.
[*] Rascals starting speed and max rotation speed has been reduced as well as changes directions less often.
[*] Three star Rascal’s dash regen has been increased from 1s to 2s.[/list]
[h3]Initial Player Experience[/h3][list]
[*] Updated and added new tutorials and training to increase clarity and added more systems to protect you, making it easier to succeed.
[*] The game will initially load you into the tutorial on first play.
[*] Input hints have been added to show the correct buttons to press for all control schemes. They now last forever on tutorial levels or appear on start or pause in other levels.
[*] Missions should not pop up in tutorials.
[*] Rascal icon and item icon shouldn’t appear on tutorial level’s pause or post game screen.
[*] Now uses the space key glyph.[/list]
[h3]UI UX[/h3][list]
[*] The chilli metre on the post game screen has been simplified to only show the chilli you are currently on.
[*] Adjusted UI navigation to be more intuitive across the whole game. You can also now directly adjust the chilli on the post game screen without having to bring up the modal.
[*] Added new UI shortcuts, you can now get to the options, missions and equipment select from the world, level and trial select screens.
[*] The shop and equipment button have been separated and will now take you directly to the selected screen with quick access to each other except when changing equipment from the post game screen.
[*] There are no longer duplicate egg counters on the pause screen.
[*] Transitions in the menu are now snappier.
[*] Wesley now prefers to show items first instead of cannon tickets.
[*] Compliments and shoutouts now appear on the side of the screen when Clucky does cool actions. Current shoutouts include Dash Break when dashing through a dashable obstacle,  Clutch when keeping an egg combo alive when it’s just about to run out, Close Call when surviving a close call and Combo Up or Rainbow Combo when increasing an egg combo.
[*] Now top scores should appear before relative scores.
[*] Added new nouns and adjectives for player names.
[*] Cannon button now shows a star required pop up if you attempt to enable it without any star collected for the level.
[*] Changed the star and rainbow celebrations effects to match the new sounds better.
[*] Added credits screen in options.
[*] The post game screen now has some unskippable parts.
[*] When the player owns no items the items equipment overlay shows a message to direct them on how to get their feathers on some.
[*] Now going to shop from in-game passes through area and level select.
[*] The back button is now hidden when selecting equipment.
[*] Cannon icons are now standardised.
[*] Adjusted options layout to be more familiar and group similar options.
[*] Each notch in the canvas scale option now increases size by 10% instead of 25% and more notches are present.
[*] Adjusted some options names.[/list]
[h3]Player Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*] Players now get Close Calls where if the run would be ended but the player has bawk or dash available, time is stopped for a duration based on their remaining time-slow bar, giving the player extra time to react to the danger.
[*] Jump/Dash/Bawk input buffers are now longer and use real or in game time whichever is smaller.
[*] Bawk now takes 3s to recover, up from 1s.
[*] Bawk now takes 60s to recharge, up from 40s.
[*] Boosts now give 2s of invulnerability, up from 1s.
[*] Player feet hitbox is now smaller to reduce floating near bridges or getting muddy walking beside mud.
[*] Camera should adjust itself when landing on floating islands.
[*] Camera should tilt towards the ground less when falling.
[*] Added Clucky dirt boost tunnelling and emerge sounds. Particles have been adjusted to match.
[*] The player now starts higher up in the air when the cannon ends and is invulnerable for longer.
[*] After boosts and cannons the player resets coyote time and has reduced gravity for a small period of time.
[*] Some Invulnerability effects now weakly bounce you off water or dirt. A wing icon appears on the shield status display when this would occur.
[*] Water bounce now gives a small Invulnerability.
[*] Score save data now contain the game version they were achieved on, as well as other stats such as the highest egg combo achieved.[/list]
[h3]Item Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*][b]Party Hat, Hand Bag and High Heels[/b] - Star Power now gives egg combo shield.
[*][b]Guitar[/b] - Reduced boost shield from 100% to 30%.
[*][b]Super Hair[/b] - Reduced bawk distance from 100% to 40%. Reduced bawk size from 50% to 30%.
[*][b]Cowboy Boots and Toolbelt[/b] Reduced bawk charges from +2 to +1.
[*][b]FPS glasses[/b] Reduced bawk charges from +3 to +2.[/list]
[h3]Level Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*] Added a new bonus level Hex Walled.
[*] Foxes no longer start behind reeds in the Fast Foxes level.
[*] Cow blocks are now longer.
[*] Multiblock fences now only have two eggs.
[*] Rolling hay now only has two eggs.
[*] Pop up sprinklers now rotate both ways.
[*] Cows now rotate around poles both ways.
[*] Fire scarecrows now move in infinity signs and are a little more scary overall.
[*] Fixed Forest spelling for bonus levels.
[*] Stoney Swamps is now called Soggy Swamps.
[*] Trampolines now have boost lines and use the boost icon.
[*] Corn camera zoom hitbox is slightly smaller.
[*] Corn pathways are slightly bigger.
[*] Lava steps are more central, move slower and are guaranteed to have some up and some down nearby.
[*] Vultures now have an additional collider for their neck.
[*] Blocks and obstacles that move or rotate should now be more consistently the same when playing on various view distances.
[*] Dirt boosts now have a bigger hitbox.
[*] Hay Boosts are now wider.[/list]
[h3]Mission Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*] Mission items only select items that are available.
[*] Added dash X dashables mission.
[*] Added collect X egg combo mission.
[*] Added complete X daily missions, mission.
[*] Now get 6 daily missions + 2 rascal missions + 3 complete daily missions each day.
[*] Adjusted mission requirements and rewards.
[*] Fixed a bug with missions which caused expired items or level requirements.
[*] Missions now only notify on 50% and 100% complete.
[*] Removed complete X one star runs and replaced some with complete X three star runs.[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3][list]
[*] Reduced quality on low and medium to allow better performance.
[*] Reduced fog and camera clipping plane distances.
[*] Increased performance when loading scenes.
[*] Quality options are now applied on start up.
[*] The world cylinder is no longer solid and only shows the faces needed.
[*] LODs have been added for the world cylinder, clouds and some animals.
[*] Music files are now streamed, saving memory.
[*] Reduced memory and CPU overhead for audio.
[*] Adjusted sound load type to save performance.
[*] Adjusted animation culling for some obstacles.[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where player movement wasn’t based on the controller joystick x axis displacement percentage and was always full left, no movement or full right.
[*] Fixed a bug where controller players could decelerate faster than keyboard players.
[*] Fixed a bug where the item icon shadow image was visible when no item icon was present on pause and post game screen.
[*] Fixed some bugs that occurred when the player was given free bawk and dash charges.
[*] Fixed some bugs with colour changing obstacles.
[*] Fixed some bugs with closing popups and navigating behind them.
[*] Fixed some bugs when switching from full game to demo.
[*] Fixed a bug where Rascal’s icon still showed on the cannon button when it wasn’t needed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Magnet didn’t work for some time after tutorial levels.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Magnet caused Rascal to collect eggs from further away.
[*] Now dirt boost duration and invulnerable time is scaled with boost power and boost invulnerable time.
[*] Dirt boost particles on the ground should appear less when under water.
[*] Fixed a bug where some music wasn’t stopping when it should.
[*] Fixed a bug where the egg combo sound was playing on death.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t navigate to the chilli metre when the next level button wasn’t present.
[*] Fixed a bug where golden eggs weren’t reset correctly on restart.
[*] Fixed a bug where music didn’t play when you restarted too fast.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could select buttons during the post game screen animation.
[*] Fixed some issues that occurred when playing on a controller when a touch screen was also present.
[*] Fixed a bug where some options were present when the device they adjusted wasn’t connected.
[*] Fixed a bug where some distance calculations were causing errors during loading.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when loading into some levels.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when dashing.
[*] Fixed a bug where some sounds weren’t being stopped on death.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t navigate to the back button in trial select.
[*] Fixed a bug which identified the incorrect control scheme as the current.
[*] Fixed a bug where dirt boost particles continued to spawn after death.
[*] Fixed a bug where you needed a mouse to use keyboard navigation.
[/list]

Patch Notes for version 1.4
Release date: 2023/10/04

[h2]PAX Patch[/h2]
[b]Time to hit the road![/b] - We recently showcased at Avcon and AVCon X Rundle Mall Plaza and now we are headed to Melbourne! We will be showcasing at PAX Australia this weekend and if you’re there make sure to come past and say hello!

[b]Confident Crocs[/b] - Some crocodiles seem to have grown bigger heads now that they have ripple and splash effects. Messy Muds has been decked out with 2 new bonus levels where the new big headed crocs will be hard to miss.
[b]Powers Pizzazz[/b] - Clucky now has some extra flair when dashing and slowing time.

However now you can choose if you want to block the game’s access to our servers completely. You can also delete all data ever sent to our servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/b3688b53ec86c8808864f46cd2add2d0ae575eb3.gif[/img]

notes.title: BAWK BAWK UPDATE 1.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for version 1.3
Release date: 2023/09/14

[h2]Area Balance[/h2]
[b]Balance Breakdown[/b] - Before we add new content to Bawk Bawk we are doing our best to make sure our current content is to a high standard. We have adjusted and nerfed a lot of blocks in Messy Muds and Lethal Lava to be [i]perfectly balanced as all things should be[/i]. Our intentions are to allow you to get further, promote good play with eggs and have more fun on these levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/af394f28568d2f8e78fcb8bcb674410b2a2e87a3.gif[/img]

[h2]Time Slow[/h2]
[b]Tick Tock It’s Time Slow O’Clock[/b] - Time slow has been adjusted with the intention of making it more useful and reducing the likelihood of being slowed by nearby obstacles that you won’t hit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/5c09f463c60c27813b1fab145d2484af9a93f5f6.gif[/img]

[h2]The Nitty Gritty[/h2]
[h3]Item Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*][b]Glasses[/b] - Increased slow scale from 30% to 45%.
[*][b]Slippers[/b] - Increased slow scale from 50% to 75%.
[*][b]Party Hat[/b], [b]Hand Bag[/b] and [b]High Heels[/b] - Star Power effectiveness now increases by 10% per star collected in the current run, up to 150% on the 3rd red star. Star Power now increases the boost duration not the speed, giving the player more control over the boost. Jump and boost amounts have been slightly adjusted.
[*][b]Pizza Hat[/b], [b]Backpack[/b], [b]Guitar[/b] and [b]Hiking Boots[/b] - Boost Power now increases the boost duration not the speed, giving the player more control over the boost.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list]
[*] Tutorial now uses the correct jump hold icons when space is jump.
[*] Tutorial guide animations now show where bawk and dash indicators are on the HUD.
[*] Tutorial walls are now more central and easier to rotate towards.
[*] Tutorial will now always be played with game speed of 1 or below even if chili is set higher.
[*] Tutorial now makes sure the player has a bawk/jump/dash when hitting a time slow.
[*] Tutorial now will make the chicken itemless during the tutorial.
[*] Increased trampoline count at end of tutorial to make them harder to miss. All tutorial trampolines are now floor trampolines.
[*] Stone circles have been replaced with new ones with more space to walk through. Now each rock rotates and scales individually and has a chance to not spawn.
[*] Reduced the amount of horses.
[*] Reduced the amount of normal, small and tiny frogs.
[*] Reduced the amount of capybaras and increased their block length.
[*] Pallet arches are now bigger and easier to go through.
[*] Now 40% of logs never dip (from 20%).
[*] Logs that don’t dip are darker and ripple animates slower.
[*] Adjusted egg locations for logs to only be on those that never dip.
[*] Boat boosts now have the boost icon.
[*] Reduced the amount of cows.
[*] Land reeds are now lower in the ground allowing the player to see past them easier.
[*] Adjusted reed egg location to not teach players into going through them into crocodiles.
[*] Adjusted croc eggs to be further away from danger.
[*] Reduced the amount of geysers (land, lava and near paths).
[*] Geysers should now be more central and overlap less (land and lava).
[*] Increased lava geyser min length (to reduce small jumps) and reduced max length (decrease too long jumps)
[*] Increased land geyser block length and now stable over config difficulties.
[*] Adjusted egg locations for clumps of dashable pots.
[*] Reduced multiblock amount of spikes and increased block length at the cost of safety distance.
[*] Increased the safe distance on lava paths from 4 to 5.
[*] Meteors now can only speed up and not slow down.
[*] Meteors minimum flight speed has been increased to 2 seconds which should reduce the amount of super fast meteors at the start of levels.
[*] Purple meteors now exist earlier in the level they are just rare.
[*] Increased hex wall block length.
[*] Adjusted lava plumes egg locations.
[*] Reduced the amount of spires.
[*] Snakes now have rope indicators.
[*] Increased Snakes block length and reduced the spread factor.
[*] Reduced the amount of snakes.
[*] Clucky now gets a little coyote time (hangs in air before falling) between jumps/glides and after boosts to help players reach consistent jump heights on faster speeds.
[*] Trials now have their own special safety blocks - pebble grass, tree grass, sprinkler grass, exploding barrels grass, wheat grass, reeds grass, geyser grass. These safety blocks should spawn more consistent amounts over different lengths.
[*] Wheat safety block is thinner and now no longer hides water and lava edges beside them.
[*] Boost invulnerable time has been adjusted to be Boost Time + 1 second. Overall players should feel more comfortable taking boosts even at higher game speeds.
[*] Giant Clucky can now jump off floor trampolines.
[*] Going through a boost now removes current gravity.
[*] Going through a boost now refreshes your jump count.
[*] Dashing over terrain of different heights should now be more consistent.
[*] All in level icons (trampoline/boost/dashable) are now 25% bigger.
[*] Feet equipment have all been adjusted to reduce model clipping.
[*] Feet equipment animations have been adjusted to reduce model clipping.
[*] Super hair now dimly glows.
[*] Trampoline colliders are now bigger.
[*] Clucky can now jump when muddy. However, being muddy lasts longer and drastically reduces jump power and glide time.
[*] Reduced zoom slow to be 10% slow (90% speed).
[*] Time slow based on the distance to the closest obstacle is now more accurate. Forward distance means more than side distance meaning you’ll go slower if the obstacle is in front of you rather than beside.
[*] Time slow is now a parabolic curve instead of linear meaning you should get less caught on objects that are close but not too close.
[*] Time slow is now increased when dashing or boosting to compensate for the extra speed.
[*] Time slow now only occurs in the last 0.5s of invulnerability so you don’t get caught on obstacles mid boost when you can just go through them.
[*] Time can now be slowed faster helping it remain useful at fast speeds or on devices with low framerates. 
[*] Time slow eases back to normal speed slower to give you time to get back into the groove.
[*] Time slow should be more consistent for bigger chickens.
[*] Time slow has been reduced from 2s base to 1s base and regen decreased from 0.0083/s to 0.0055/s.
[*] Time slow now has a minimum amount required to be able to start slowing time. The indicator changes colour when falling below this threshold. 
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed some issues with block cloning for multiblocks.
[*] Fixed a bug where top barrels beside single barns could be floating. They now get destroyed when the bottom barrels are bawked.
[*] Fixed a bug where time slow triggered on dirt underneath grass or islands when landing safely above them.
[*] Fixed a bug where random orientation lava plumes had an incorrect config set and was spawning normal lava plumes.
[*] Fixed a bug where time slow scale stat was actually reducing the speed at which you move towards your max slow. Whoops!
[*] Fixed a bug where you got sent into the floor when dashing through boosts in Frantic Farms.
[*] Fixed a bug where one trampoline bounce counted as more than one professional bounce. You get Professional Bouncer, You get Professional Bouncer, Everyone gets Professional Bouncer!
[*] Fixed a bug where the last sign selected in level select didn’t blur during the camera transition back to the menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could be stuck in time slow for a long time on the tutorial if you held jump for too long or jumped too early before a jump line.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to get infinite slow time and caused issues with the time slow indicator when wearing the Space Helmet.
[*] Fixed a bug where dying when wet caused the dash to permanently be down until the next time you get wet and it runs out.
[*] Fixed a bug where options were not applied instantly.
[*] Fixed a bug where stone circles were not dissolving when nearby.
[*] Fixed a bug where bawking pots close up still led to player death.

notes.title: BAWK BAWK UPDATE 1.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for version 1.2
Release date: 2023/08/24

[h2]Item Balance[/h2]
We changed almost every item for the better! Making sure each item has an opportunity to shine. Our goal was to simplify the stats so that players can make meaningful choices, while bringing some of the less-picked items inline with the more popular items. For a detailed breakdown of the item changes, check the Nitty Gritty section below. 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/c8f6f2446b9856a6066e47ed66042b23183877ca.gif[/img]

[h2]Performance Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Particle Party Poopers[/b] - reduced the number of particles used in a few places, sometimes down by an order of 10! Also, all particle systems will turn on closer to the player. These changes have reduced frame lags when bawking, dashing, and when certain obstacles are prevalent in levels.
[*][b]Memory Mischief[/b] - Bawk balls and lava trails are now allocated ahead of time to prevent frame drops when bawking and lag on lava levels. Not only that, but all obstacles have had their behavior updated to prevent unnecessary lookups and memory allocations during gameplay. Making for a much smoother run.
[*][b]Complete Collision Calibration[/b] - Reworked [i]all of the collisions in the game[/i] this was a massive task, but very worth it! Sorted objects into layers to make sure collisions were only processed between objects when they should be. Reduced the number of raycasts used for ground detection and improved other raycasts to work as intended. Larger dash through colliders have been added too, making it more likely for you to gain back your dash charges.
[*] More efficient management of obstacles that react based on distance to clucky. These checks now happen far less frequently.
[*] Reduced the resolution of cloud dithering to gain back a tonne of frames on lava levels, especially noticeable on Macs.
[*] Removed unnecessary loading and saving during level load screens to improve load times.
[*] Now uses GPU Instancing for even more materials!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/3d541ac3e326ecc039923c44959c3347237c11bf.gif[/img]


[i]Based on feedback we have changed the default jump action key to spacebar from w/up. There is an option in the menu to switch it back if desired.[/i]


[h2]The Nitty Gritty[/h2]

[h3]Item Adjustments[/h3][list]
[*][b]Battle Helm[/b] - Removed heavy. Reduced armour from +2 to +1.
[*][b]Hard Hat[/b] - Removed armour.
[*][b]Bucket Hat[/b] - Gives +50% debuff recovery. Gives +60% debuff slow resist. Reduced armour from +2 to +1. Short sighted adjusted to be less distracting.
[*][b]Chestplate[/b] - Removed increased fall speed. Now the description shows more stats instead of keywords.
[*][b]Rock Feet[/b] - Removed safe landing. Removed fall speed. Gives +1 Armour.
[*][b]Steel Toes[/b] - Increased Armour from +1 to +2. Gives +50% fall speed.
[*][b]Super Hair[/b] - Removed bawk shield as it felt underwhelming. Increased bawk distance from +20% to +100%. Increased bawk size from +20% to +50%.
[*][b]FPS Glasses[/b] - The camera no longer tilts when turning. Reduced bawk recovery from +180% to +150%. Increased bawk recharge from +120% to +150%.
[*][b]Tool Belt[/b] - Removed bawk recovery, recharge, size and distance. Increased bawk charges from +1 to +2.
[*][b]Cowboy Boots[/b] - Removed bawk recovery. Increased bawk charges from +1 to +2.
[*][b]Ram Horns[/b] - Removed dash recovery.
[*][b]Cat Headphones[/b] - Reduced dash recovery from -140% to -200%. Gives -50% dash length. The heart bawk ball is now the same size as the original bawk ball and its visuals have been adjusted.
[*][b]Oxygen Tank[/b] - Removed dash recovery and recharge. Gives +125% dash distance.
[*][b]Roller Skates[/b] - Removed dash recovery. Gives +25% dash distance.
[*][b]Space Helmet[/b] - Increased dodge time from +50% to +75%.
[*][b]Glasses[/b] - Increased dodge recovery and slow from +20% to +30%.
[*][b]Hero Cape[/b] - Increased dodge recovery from +40% to +50%.
[*][b]Slippers[/b] - Increased dodge slow from +30% to +50%.
[*][b]Glider[/b] - Increased glide time from +40% to +50%.
[*][b]Monarch Wings[/b] - Removed star jump. Gives +20% Jump Power.
[*][b]Jetpack[/b] - Removed star jump and star boost.
[*][b]Pirate Hat[/b] - Gives 1 extra value to shiny eggs.
[*][b]Parrot[/b] - Gives +33% egg combo shield.
[*][b]Party Hat[/b] - Gives 50% Star Power. (star power gives star jump and star boost)
[*][b]Handbag[/b] - Gives 60% Star Power. (star power gives star jump and star boost)
[*][b]High Heels[/b] - Gives 50% Star Power. (star power gives star jump and star boost)
[*][b]Pizza Hat[/b] - Gives 50% Boost Power. (boost power gives boost jump and boost boost)
[*][b]Back Pack[/b] - Gives 50% Boost Power. (boost power gives boost jump and boost boost)
[*][b]Guitar[/b] - Reduced Boost Shield from 200% to 100%. Gives 30% Boost Power. (Keep in mind boost shield now scales with boost time and this applies after that) (boost power gives boost jump and boost boost)
[*][b]Hiking boots[/b] - Gives 50% Boost Power. (boost power gives boost jump and boost boost)
[*][b]Top Hat[/b] - Gives 40% Turn Speed. (Turn speed now increases turn acceleration and turn speed limit)
[*][b]Farmer Boots[/b] - Gives 40% Turn Speed. (Turn speed now increases turn acceleration and turn speed limit)[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list]
[*] Selected buttons in the menus now shine for better visual clarity.
[*] You can now click anywhere on the item in the equipment menu to change items.
[*] Cannon now prioritizes going to Rascal over going to the highest star.
[*] Boost shield now scales with boost time.
[*] Players now have better turning control during dashes and boosts.
[*] Players should now find it easier to break dashable objects and collect eggs while dashing.
[*] Time slows now scale with game speed so it's still worth it when playing on max chili. Time slows should now feel more consistent and you should get stuck less on surrounding objects.
[*] Reduced player base max fall speed to 10 m/s so you don’t fall faster than you can keep up.
[*] Added 2 extra tips to the loading scene.
[*] Player’s jump height cap has been increased. Minimum camera height has been slightly increased to accommodate.
[*] Adjusted the seed for Bouncing Barrels and Speedy Sheep to reduce early difficulty.
[*] Path supports are now dangerous. Path eggs are higher off ground (for when jumping over broken paths). Path geysers and fish no longer spawn eggs. Path pillars no longer get bawked away forever. Path breaks happen more frequently but now must be a certain minimum size.
[*] Water death is now lower and you can survive but get wet if you only dip your toes.
[*] Sprinkler wall indicators are now more intuitive. Now players can look for the most green or least red.
[*] Stationary Wagon Wheels now have longer blocks, spawn less and have more consistent difficulty scaling.
[*] Rolling wagon wheel eggs are now in better locations.
[*] Exploding dizzy barrels now have longer blocks, spawn less, increased range but only pop if you are on the ground. You can no longer die from colliding with the barrels.
[*] Frog eggs are now in better locations.
[*] Reeds are now easier to identify if in water or on land. Land reeds now are darker, have longer blocks and have land after them. Water reeds now spread out less and have water after them. Water and Land reed patches now have safety blocks after them.
[*] Boats are now positioned slightly lower and you can land on the front of them. Boats now have longer blocks.
[*] Increased the amount of floating logs in the water and now 20% of them never dip.
[*] Tree logs now fall earlier so you have more time to react. Tree logs eggs are now in better locations
[*] Removed water sprinkler walls from Stoney Swamps.
[*] Paths gems are now purple.
[*] Pillars are now completely dashable and bawkable.
[*] Meteors and Rolling Fireballs now come in a range of colours.
[*] Lava plumes maximum block length has been reduced so you don’t need multiple back to back dash jumps.
[*] Hex walls no longer have different sizes and are slightly easier to jump over. Hex wall eggs are now in better locations
[*] Flamethrowers can now trigger earlier and later.
[*] Lava steps min heights adjusted to be higher now can have trampolines.
[*] Levels with lava into water blocks or vice versa now have a small dirt in between them.
[*] Less water sprinklers in water trials.
[*] Trials can now have hex walls.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Reduced unfair log block placement in trials.
[*] Reduced the amount of unintended grass in water levels.
[*] Striking snakes now has safety blocks in between blocks.
[*] Removed the extra "l" in Leaping Lilies.
[*] Global highscores should be more accurate and you should no longer see duplicates of your own score.
[*] Fixed an error that occurred on load for the notification controller.
[*] Spamming the Esc button during load screen no longer quits the game.
[*] Removed a bug which caused the player to not start with the correct  amount of time slow.
[*] Time slow now works in tutorial no matter the chili level.
[*] Removed a bug where the camera zoomed in when lily pad jumping.
[*] Players should find it harder to fall through lily pads into death.
[*] Fixed a bug which stopped players from getting achievements like Shiny and Hot Stuff.
[*] Cloud lightning can now happen on the first play from the load screen.
[*] Players should now land safely more often.
[*] The camera should no longer zoom in for pipes when they have been bawked away.
[*] Bawking the snail trail no longer bawks the snail away.
[*] Fixed some unintended death interactions on Water and Lava steps.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could dash while dashing, extending your dash.
[*] Fixed some spelling mistakes on item descriptions and made key words more consistent.
[*] Fixed some star and rascal issues on Leaping Lilies which caused them not to spawn correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could pause during loading.
[*] Fixed a bug where the pause screen flashed on and off at the start of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where sprinkler walls were on when they were meant to be off.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the pause end screen to have an overlay be open upon transition. Can no longer press buttons during the transition.
[*] Fixed a bug which allowed users to restart mid cannon to get free eggs and distance.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused short sighted to not be visible after restart.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused eggs to spawn within hay walls.
[/list]

[h3]Notes[/h3][list]
[*] Animal collisions have now been simplified for now and we may reintroduce specific interactions at a later date.
[*] We may look to add an option that changes the distance constant particles turn on at a later date.
[*] We may look to add an option that changes cloud dither maps at a later date.
[/list]

notes.title: BAWK BAWK UPDATE 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/6c7fc42e00ec39bdff4927c0f186ef1c59a20b76.png[/img]

[h2]New Challenges Have Arrived![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/ae13574d9ff845af58b3cd5d2d41401477524a21.gif[/img]
[list]
  [*] [b]Rock around the clock![/b] Circles of stones have been spotted in pleasant pastures.
  [*] [b]Ooh pointy![/b] Short walls made of wooden spikes now appear in lava levels.
  [*] [b]What the hex?[/b] Curiously glowing hexagonal walls now pop up in lava levels.
  [*] [b]Sinking steps![/b] Lava steps now rise and fall, making it trickier to land safely.
  [*] [b]Heads up![/b] Vultures now swoop down when Clucky gets near them.
  [*] [b]What does the blue flaming fox say?[/b] Red foxes in lava levels have been replaced with Flaming Foxes (and they’re blue!).
[/list]

[h2]Big Ol’ Balance Overhaul[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/926009eaceb125952db3496a429f29c79899e367.gif[/img]
[list]
  [*] [b]Pleasant Pastures[/b] other than the inclusion of stone circles in several levels, we’ve make some minor tweaks to pleasant pastures to make it a bit easier to get high scores.
  [*] [b]Frantic Farms[/b] had some issues with blocks being too close together. Most notably dashable objects and sprinkler walls made it very easy to run into obstacles on the other side of them. Increasing safe distances between obstacles has been the biggest change here.
  [*] [b]Bustlin’ Barnyards[/b] number of obstacles has been reduced. Speed of tractors and some animals reduced.
  [*] [b]Messy Muds[/b] number of obstacles has been reduced. Safe distances after blocks was also increased a lot here, mostly on water blocks and after reeds.
  [*] [b]Lethal Lava[/b] has had some of the biggest changes. With new blocks, balancing has been needed to keep it more challenging than all other areas, but still achievable. Obstacle counts have been reduced and configurations now allow for a more gradual increase in difficulty. [/list]


[h2]The Nitty Gritty[/h2]

[h3]Level Tweaks and Nerfs[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Less fish spawn on long stretches of water.
  [*] Less clotheslines spawn, balanced empty vs full clothes lines spawn rate, and they now have a larger safe distance behind them.
  [*] Sprinkler walls now have a collider and a larger tank capacity. They show running water animation less often and have a larger safe distance behind them.
  [*] The amount of long Sprinklers that spawn has been nerfed.
  [*] Corn now has a larger safe distance behind it and eggs spawn further away from the fences.
  [*] Hay Walls are less frequent late run. They also spawn with less tall segments early run and have more space in front and behind them.
  [*] Hay stacks spawn less and are more spread along the cylinder.
  [*] Cart boosts spawn more frequently in Frantic Farms. There are now less large bundles of hay next to them as well.
  [*] Tractors pulling trailers now have bigger gaps between them and less full trailers. They also no longer spawn eggs under their first trailer.
  [*] Scarecrows sway slower, also spawn less and have more space in front and behind.
  [*] Scarecrow traps spawn less, have less space in front and behind and can now be repeated.
  [*] Fertilizer spawns less and is more evenly spread out.
  [*] Rolling hay bales have slowed down, but can spawn more around the cylinder as well as spawning more in a row.
  [*] Less Donkeys spawn, less repeated donkeys early run.
  [*] Rabbits are now more spread out and can spawn in different length rows.
  [*] Rakes are now less frequent late run. They also pop up earlier to make them easier to spot.
  [*] Kangaroos have slowed down a bit and are now less frequent late run.
  [*] Reduced the number of Horses that spawn.
  [*] Reduced the maximum amount of barrels that can spawn.
  [*] Leaf stacks are now balanced slightly harder than hay stacks.
  [*] Reduced the speed of Tractors.
  [*] Less barns can spawn and more spawn open.
  [*] Reduce the number of sheep that spawn as well as their tracking speed.
  [*] Foxes have been slowed. Less foxes spawn, jumping doesn’t slow foxes as much.
  [*] Less rotating fan boats spawn, and the speed the fans apply to Clucky has been reduced. The boats also move slower and can spawn back to back.
  [*] Floating logs now float for longer and have a faster and more obvious dip animation.
  [*] Floating logs now always have safe distance after the water they spawn in, also the water they spawn in is now longer, but the logs remain near the middle.
  [*] Less mud and less pigs in mud spawn.
  [*] Pigs now animate with different timings.
  [*] Less crocodiles spawn.
  [*] Frogs now all have a consistent safe distance behind them.
  [*] Less harvesters, larger safe distance after, and eggs stop moving once the harvester is bawked.
  [*] Less tractors stuck in mud spawn early run.
  [*] Pallets appear a lot less often.
  [*] Tortoises repeat less in a row.
  [*] Clucky now bounces on lily pads! They are now bigger too, making it easier to jump back onto grass. In the Leaping Lilies level, bouncing on a lily pad also gives you score.
  [*] Pipes are now far easier to jump through. Larger half pipes have been added to the mix. Timeslow of pipes is now not as slow, and the camera zooms in better!
  [*] Less Burnt Scarecrows spawn, and they appear back-to-back less often early run. Also fixed an animation issue where their arms moved in ways they shouldn’t have.
  [*] Balanced lava geysers in lava to be slightly harder than fish. Laga geysers on land are slightly harder again. Lava levels no longer spawn lava without lava geysers.
  [*] Reduced the number of spires that spawn as it was almost impossible to pass through them sometimes.
  [*] Pots, Urns, and Pillars now spawn less and get harder more gradually. Pots also have a better hitbox.
  [*] Fire Foxes are now slightly easier. They track you less and less of them spawn.
  [*] Boost rings now at a better jump height.
  [*] Balanced rolling fireballs so that they are better spread out and less of them spawn. They also get harder more gradually than before.
  [*] Lava paths now have less geysers and can be shorter.
  [*] Reduced the number of Lava Plumes that spawn and they’re now a bit easier early run.
  [*] Reduced the number of Lava Snails that spawn.
  [*] Reduced the number of Snakes that spawn.
  [*] Meteors now more reliably fall in front of the player, when they now make a fiery crash sound! They also start further out than the clouds and dissolve in rather than grow. Now remain spinning for a short time after impact. They’ve also been balanced to be a bit easier early run.
  [*] Volatile Volcano was renamed to Striking Snakes.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
  [*] The cannon now makes a big boom when it fires.
  [*] Wesley’s voice is a bit quieter to better fit in with other sounds.
  [*] Tutorial now has easier to navigate walls, and the jump line is a bit earlier for fence.
  [*] You now get eggs for catching Rascal for the first time in a level.
  [*] Donkeys spawn 2 eggs instead of 4 so you don’t have to run into other donkeys to collect them all.
  [*] Debuffs cause you to slow forwards movement less.
  [*] Added egg spawns to a whole bunch of obstacles that didn’t have them before.
  [*] Very Small Cabbage Main has been renamed to Cabbage Calamity.
  [*] Wesleys welcome now starts when you’ve arrived at the store rather than while you’re moving to it.
  [*] The fence buttons on the main menu now have a better selection indicator.
  [*] Timeslow is now smoother, slows down to target speed faster, faster to return to normal speed.
  [*] Better celebration animation when you get a new high score.
  [*] Star and high score celebrations are now anchored to the side of the screen even on ultra wide screens.
  [*] Clouds now dissolve in, rather than grow in. This makes a big difference to the appearance of clouds on the lava level specifically.
  [*] Spires now have more colour variations.
  [*] Screen shake now occurs when you bawk, when meteors land, and when the star cannon fires. Making each of these interactions feel more powerful!
  [*] Eggs that spawn on paths now are more central on the path.
  [*] Rotating floors are now less bloomy in lava levels.
  [*] Rolling hay and fireballs now have a more rumbly, bass heavy sound.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Reeds can now be bawked.
  [*] The reeds that sometimes spawn with crocodiles no longer act like walls.
  [*] Fixed a bunch of null reference errors.
  [*] Fixed an issue where the dash button got stuck in recharging state during the tutorial.
  [*] Pots and Urns now correctly initialise. They also remove their dash icon once bawked.
  [*] Debuffs now affect rotation boosts.
  [*] Trials and bonus levels no longer show the unlock animation.
  [*] Bawking Rolling Hay now stops their eggs from rotating.
  [*] Debuff objects no longer get phased.
  [*] Achievements that were achieved in the demo are now unlocked in the full game.
  [*] Achievements that have been unlocked, but not synced to Steam, are now synced when you launch the game.
  [*] Reports some out of game achievements as they happen, rather than after the next run.
  [*] You can now achieve the Professional Bouncer achievement.
  [*] Mud is left behind when you bawk Tractors that are stuck in mud.
  [*] Prevent back-to-back reeds to reduce the chance of spawning infinite water.
  [*] Eggs near trees no longer lead in random directions.
  [*] Rascal no longer appears incorrectly on bonus levels.
  [*] Fixed an issue that was causing the chili modal to be stuck open.
  [*] Clouds now always spawn then they should.
  [*] Bonus levels show the item board when they have a Rascal catch mission.
  [*] Eggs of rolling fireballs and lava snails now stop rotating once the obstacle has been bawked.
  [*] Clucky now no longer randomly falls through broken path blocks.
  [*] Clucky can no longer jump through the sides of islands. These now have danger colliders.
  [*] Rascal catch celebration now plays in real-time.
[/list]

[h3]Performance tweaks[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Now uses GPU Instancing for more materials.
  [*] Proximity trigger no longer continues calculations once triggered.
  [*] Music assets now stream, rather than decompressing on load.
[/list]

notes.title: BAWK BAWK UPDATE 0.44
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/6c7fc42e00ec39bdff4927c0f186ef1c59a20b76.png[/img]

[h2]Overhaul to Game Speed and Scores[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Jump on the gain train.[/b] Game speed now increases at a constant rate, irrelevant of your game speed option. The game speed option now controls how fast you go at the start of the run. When the base game speed (1 chilli) catches up, your game speed will then start to increase.
[*][b]One score to rule them all.[/b] Now that everyone's on the same game speed for higher scores, this has removed the need to have separate scoreboards for different game speeds. You can now see all scores, even those from different chillies.
[*][b]Chilli out![/b] We've added the game speed chilli slider to the end game screen, showing you what game speed you selected and your effort each run, to help you match your gameplay to how spicy you like it. 
[*][b]A mythical end to scoreless.[/b] Instead of mythic items having the scoreless attribute. They now have a mythic attribute and scores gained with these items can be submitted. Get ready to see a new set of high scores for Walled!
[*][b]Smashing scoreboards![/b] - Reworked the scoreboards, fixing duplicates when viewing your local scoreboard and displaying incorrect scores. High scores will be updated every 12 hrs. Trials are the exception, and will continue to update every 30 mins due to their time limit. An option to automatically submit your high scores is included to make getting your name on the board simpler!
[/list]
Don't forget to re-submit those high scores and put yourself back on the leaderboards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/d922e9b5fac511d00848d208ebb71f28662a99fa.gif[/img]

[h2]Fire the Cannons![/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Cannon ahead.[/b] Speed through the start of the level by catching a cannon ride to your highest achieved star. The cannon's power can get you as far as the 3rd red star. In as quick as 15 seconds.
[*][b]Tickets please.[/b] To catch a cannon ride, you need to use a cannon pass. Cannon passes are available from Wesley's Wares and certain Missions.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197003/758b33afed7f7a9c3355fec63543ef4fd75999ea.gif[/img]

[h2]Mission Mayhem![/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Do all the things![/b] Added a whole stack of missions to do with performing certain actions. Bawk, glide, dash, and run your way to more eggs!
[*][b]I can has mission eggs?[/b] Missions now actually award the eggs they say they do.
[*][b]Fully decked out mate.[/b] Missions can now require you to be wearing a specific item.
[*][b]More of what you love.[/b] Love catching Rascal? So do we! Now you can catch the Rascal for two missions each day. Doing so gives you some cannon passes to use. Wanted posters will reappear when you can catch Rascal from missions.
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs or issues please post here: https://discord.gg/9ugmz7F9uw

[hr][/hr]

[h2]The Nitty Gritty[/h2]

[h3]Level Tweaks and Nerfs[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Doggos Roam Free.[/b] Show-dogs that jump hoops gain more airtime and they can be found running freely without the need to jump hoops. Dogs can also be found playing chasey with ducks 'round the park.
[*][b]Mumma Duck's on Guard.[/b] Giant ducks have come out to play, and chase the good bois away! All giant ducks have also agreed to give each other a bit more space.
[*][b]Bigger Ducklings.[/b] Ducklings have grown up, eating well and gaining in size! But will spawn less mouths to feed for Mumma duck.
[*][b]Too Rocky.[/b] Stubbing your toes on rocks should happen less often as fewer spawn.
[*][b]Walls Be Gone.[/b] Stone walls have more gaps to run through with more varieties to choose from.
[*][b]Fun Fences.[/b] Fences are smarter and won’t stack behind each other as much.
[*][b]I Can’t See The Bubbles![/b] Fish are now further back, they spread out less and the minimum length of water with fish is a longer.
[/list]


[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*]You will now get a prompt to choose a name on your first time viewing the leaderboards.
[*]Now using the correct icon for leaderboards button on the end of game screen.
[*]Tutorial now gives you more time to read “move” before it’s too late!
[*]Tutorial now has increased length between hay stacks.
[*]Fixed a bug in tutorial where the bawk button showed as transparent when it should have been solid.
[*]Added a quit confirmation to prevent accidental escape of game.
[*]Mouse button actions now align with the UI shown on screen.
[*]You can now press the back button on controller to close high score and mission overlays at the end of the game. Made the high score and mission overlay more controller friendly.
[*]Home screen navigation is now more intuitive. Navigating down from missions now goes back to the previous button you came from. Overall navigation changes made to feel more intuitive and friendly to the player.
[*]When you exit the profile screen it cancels name editing.
[*]Improved slot icons to give a better indication of where items will equip.
[*]Added a new set of loading tips, and updated existing tips.
[*]Shop left button now navigates left (instead of right).
[*]New stylised scroll bars.
[*]Name change is now limited to once a day.
[*]Complete X runs missions now require at least 1 star.
[*]Fixed Wesley’s model to give them a better posture.
[*]Gave players back the eggs from missions that were not gained correctly.
[*]Removed previous saved scores on 1 and 2 chill as they are now too slow to be fair for high scores. 
[*]Some items will now appear bigger on the menu.
[*]Missions are now displayed in a logical order, egg missions, ticket missions and then completed missions at the bottom.
[*]While playing the tutorial, the default button selected is now the restart button.
[*]Now says loading instead of no scores when loading the online leaderboards.
[*]Added another visual variant to Doggos.
[*]Added new animations for dash and boost to make it feel more powerful.
[*]Equipment screen shop button is now more visible and has changed location.
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]R key no longer restarts the level (oops! This was a leftover from the very first build of Bawk Bawk back in 2021!)
[*]Path hobs now reset themselves properly and no longer stay destroyed on reset.
[*]Golden eggs don’t continue their collect animation after restart.
[*]No more eggs fighting for the same spot.
[*]Removed egg spawning underneath trampolines on islands.
[*]Particles emitted by the player now clear correctly on death.
[*]The connection to steamworks is now closed correctly when you quit the game.
[*]Improved chicken model animations when wearing items to reduce clipping.
[*]Adjust item placements when wearing for better viewing.
[*]Fixed some null errors.
[/list]

[h3]Hotfix v0.45[/h3]
[list]
[*] Levels adjusted to feel less empty. More eggs, ducks, fences, walls, and less back to back (fishless) water.
[*] Fixed some issues that occurred when viewing leaderboards.
[/list]
